Commentary.Commentary: Mohammad Nabi is having a chat with Brian Murgatroyd. Nabi says that it is a good total on the board as it is a slow pitch. Tells that they were looking to go after the pacers and put them off their line and length as hitting the spinners was difficult. Adds that he tried his best to get the ball in his areas and punish them. Nabi says the plan was to stay as long as possible and hit the bad balls. On the total, Nabi feels it is a good total and hopes they can defend it.

Earlier, it was a debutant who surprised everyone. Rahmanullah Gurbaz took the bull by the horns with a 24-ball 43, giving Afghanistan the early momentum. Zimbabwe managed to stall the proceedings post the Powerplay but could not sustain the same for long. Sean Williams was the only bowler who escaped punishment, with figures of 4-0-16-2. Can Zimbabwe offer any fight? Stay tuned for their reply.

The scorecard read 109/4 at the end of the 15th over. At that stage, 160 looked to be a possibility. But then, came the attack. Jarvis went for 10 off his final two balls in the 16th over and that gave the momentum to the Afghans. The next over from Chatara went for 26, which had four successive sixes. Then the next three balls disappeared as well as Afghanistan went on a rampage. Najibullah Zadran and Mohammad Nabi staged a mammoth stand of 107 in just 40 balls as their team galloped away.
Wow. Some hitting. What happened? When how? From turning into a snooze fest, this attack has woken everyone up from slumber.

OUT! A wicket to end the innings. A simple catch. Full and outside off, Nabi looks to clear long on but he is not quite able to get underneath it. The ball takes the toe end of the bat and lobs towards long on where Ryan Burl takes it calmly. AFGHANISTAN FINISH ON 197/5!
Driven through the covers by the batsman. One run added to the total.

FOUR! Good shot from Najibullah! Full toss outside off, Najibullah stands still and lofts this towards the extra cover region for a boundary. The fielder at long off runs in from long off to try and stop the boundary but he is nowhere close to it. Afghanistan are getting close to 200 here.
Full on middle, pushed back to the bowler. Chatara collects and looks to have a shy at the bowler's end but Nabi gets back in.

Full toss on middle, Nabi lofts this towards long off. It looked like it was going for a boundary but Ainsley runs in from  long off and makes an excellent diving stop. Keeps the batsman to only a single.
Full toss, on middle, Nabi flicks it through mid-wicket and calls for two. The throw comes in and Najibullah is gone for all money but the bowler fumbles. Hits the stumps with his hand instead.
Tendai Chatara to bowl the final over. Can he RESTRICT Afghanistan under 200? 3-0-45-1 so far.
SIX! A flat hit to end the over! Boy, 200 is on now. A low full toss outside off, Najibullah reaches out and carves it over extra cover! 15 from the over, 80 from the last 4!

Full and around off, chipped down to long off. The fielder comes running in but the ball drops down in front of him. He misses it but luckily for him, Ryan Burl gets across from long on to stop the boundary. Two runs taken.

FOUR! Unlucky this for Jarvis! Bowls an excellent yorker around off, but Najibullah gets his bat down in time and guides this past the short third man fielder for a boundary. Jarvis will feel hard done by as he bowled a good yorker but cricket can be cruel at times.
Very full delivery on middle, Nabi pushes this to long on for a single. Good bowling this.
Full delivery outside off, Najibullah drives this uppishly towards cover for another single.
Full delivery on middle, Nabi lofts this towards deep mid-wicket but only a single.
Kyle Jarvis is back! His figures read 3-0-38-0! Can he finish on a high?

Good fielding in the deep! Shorter on off, Nabi drags his pull wide of deep square leg. The man in the deep moves to his left and saves a certain boundary. 25 off the over. 51 off the last 2. Zimbabwe being taken down viciously.
Finally some respite for the bowler. The pour down of sixes have calmed down for the moment at least! Good length ball around off, NZ hits it hard but finds deep point for a single.

FOUR! Just short of the ropes there. Zadran gets to his fifty in style. It has come at a very quick time here. Full outside off, Zadran smashes it flat over point. The ball bounces just inside the ropes. He raises his bat as his teammates applaud his knockout innings here.
WIDE! Pressure on Madziva. He misses his line and bowls one way outside off. It is on the wrong side of the tramline. Zadran throws his bat at it but misses.

SIX! Slower ball gone terribly wrong! Madziva attempts a change of pace but ends up serving a full toss down the leg side. Madziva gets down on one knee and swings it over the square leg fence for the third consecutive maximum of the over.
SIX! 6 IN 6 FOR Afghanistan! Another short ball around off, Zadran picks it early and once again demolishes it over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum. It is raining sixes here.
SIX! 5th six in a row for Afghanistan. Back of a length ball around off, Zadran gets on his back foot and smashes his pull over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Neville Madziva is back on. 2-0-9-0, his figures so far.
SIX! Nabi will not missing out on this delivery! Four sixes in a row! Full delivery outside off, Nabi lofts over the extra cover region for another maximum. This is mayhem out there.
SIX! Another one! Nabi is on fire here! Another full delivery around off, Nabi lofts this nicely over the mid-wicket fielder for another maximum. Zimbabwe completely losing the plot here.
SIX! Bowls a full delivery on off, Nabi stands still and lofts this over the bowler's head for back-to-back maximums. Afghanistan is gaining momentum here.
SIX! Slower short ball on off, Nabi rocks back and pulls it over the mid-wicket region for a huge maximum. It went into the second tier here. Excellent stuff this from Nabi.
The batsman gets an inside edge on that which goes fine down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Full delivery on middle, Nabi drives this nicely down the ground but unfortunately for him, it hits the stumps on the bowler's end and rolls towards mid on. The batters can only take a single.
Tendai Chatara is back. 2-0-19-1, his figures so far.

SIX! Excellent shot! Jarvis bowls a full delivery on middle, Najibullah lofts this over the long on region for a huge maximum. The ball went high in the air and ended up being a 76 metre six. Good end to the over. 14 runs coming off it.
FOUR! Slower short ball aimed at the body, Najibullah rocks back and pulls it past the fine leg fielder for a boundary.
Short delivery on middle, Nabi pulls this towards square leg for another single. Only four runs have come off this over.
Short delivery on middle, Najibullah tucks it away towards square leg and crosses over for a single.
Very full delivery on middle, Nabi pushes this to long on and takes another single.
Back of a length delivery on middle, Najibullah flicks it to the leg side for a single.
Kyle Jarvis is back on. 2-0-24-0, his figures so far.
Full delivery on middle, Nabi flicks it to mid-wicket and takes a couple. Excellent running from the two batsmen. 8 runs came from the over.
FREE HIT! Full delivery on middle, Nabi looks to flick but gets an inside edge towards square leg for a couple.
Free Hit coming up.
NO BALL! Second bouncer of the over and that is why it is given a no ball. Slower short ball down the leg side, Nabi looks to flick but misses. Free Hit coming up.
Full delivery outside off, Najibullah drives this to the cover region for a single.
Short ball outside off, Nabi rocks on his back foot and punches this nicely towards cover for a single.
Slower ball on middle, Najibullah pushes it towards the off side and takes off for a quick single.
Short delivery outside off, Najibullah lets it go to the keeper.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Down the leg side, worked through mid-wicket for a single.

EDGED AND FOUR!  Short delivery around off, Najibullah looks to cut but gets an outside edge towards the third man region for another boundary. Najibullah looking to up the ante here. 100 up for Afghanistan.
SIX! A short ball outside off, Zadran pulls it over mid-wicket!
Mohammad Nabi walks in.

OUT! Caught! Gone this time. Gosh. That went miles in the air. Flighted outside off, Afghan jumps out once again, aiming to repeat his previous ball's dose but this time he skies it high in the night sky. Does not have enough distance and Ryan Burl does very well to take the skier at long on. Are the Afghans losing the plot?
SIX! AUDACIOUS! Full and outside off, Afghan comes down the track and slogs it wayyyy over mid-wicket! First boundary after 31 balls.
Ainsley Ndlovu again. 3-0-18-0 so far.
Outside off, Najibullah looks to push but misses. Just a run from the over.
A short ball outside off, Zadran looks to pull but misses.

Huge shout for LBW, turned down! Pitching outside leg. The bowler was initially confident and celebrating but did not ask his captain to go for the review. Ball Tracker confirms. This one stayed low from a length and caught Najibullah in the crease. He was hit on the pads as he looked to flick.
A short ball again, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
A slower bouncer outside off, Afghan looks to pull but misses. The ball bounces in front of the keeper.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Neville Madziva comes into the attack for the first time tonight!
Down the leg side, helped past Hamilton Masakadza at short fine leg for a couple. 4-0-16-2 for Williams tonight. A sensational spell!
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
WIDE. Down the leg side, flick shot missed.
Full and around off, Zadran looks to slog but misses and is hit on the chest.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
Najibullah Zadran is the next man in!

OUT! CAUGHT! Tarakai is out of here! Loopy ball on off which bounced a little extra, Tarakai looks to push it towards the off side but the ball bounces on him and it goes off the upper half of his bat towards cover.  Ainsley Ndlovu there takes a simple catch. Zimbabwe are making a comeback in the game by restricting the run flow and also picking up wickets.
Short delivery on off, Tarakai cuts it towards point for nothing.
Sean Williams is back into the attack.
Loopy ball on off, Tarakai pushes it to cover and takes off for a single. There is a mix-up between the batsman but no harm is done.
The batsman plays a pull shot to this short delivery. One run added to the total.
Flighted ball on middle, Tarakai lofts this to mid-wicket and takes a single.
Floated delivery on middle, Afghan flicks it towards the leg side for a single.
Full delivery on middle, Asghar comes down the track and drives this back to the bowler.
Flatter delivery on middle, Tarakai pushes it to long on for a single.
Ainsley Ndlovu is back on. 2-0-13-0 so far.
Comes down the track but the ball holds on the surface. Tarakai pushes it uppishly, wide of cover, towards long off for a run.
Outside off, Tarakai looks   to slog but misses. The ball goes past the inner half of the bat.
On middle and off, Afghan looks to slog but the ball goes off the inner half of the bat towards deep mid-wicket. A single taken.
Landed outside off, cut straight to point.
On middle and off, worked through mid-wicket for a run.
Landed outside off, pushed through point for a single.
Yesterday's hero for Zimbabwe, Ryan Burl, to bowl his leggies.
Outside off, Najeeb looks to cut but misses.
Full and outside off, pushed wide of long off for one.
Outside off, punched off the back foot for a run.
On middle, pushed through mid on for a single.
Outside off, Afghan looks to run this down to third man but misses.
Full and outside off, Afghan lunges to defend.
Around off, watchfully defended.
SIX! Up and over! Full and around off, Tarakai skips down the track and sends it sailing over long on!
On middle, worked through mid-wicket for a run.
Dropped short, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
Slower ball, Najeeb looks to run it down to third man but misses.

SAFE. Full and outside off, Tarakai looks to defend but the ball skids through to beat the outside edge. Taylor collects and whips off the bails, appealing for a stumping once more. It is referred upstairs and this time, the third umpire does not take too much time.
Oh dear... third umpire again. Another stumping appeal. Tarakai looks well in.
Asghar Afghan walks in at number 4, replacing Gurbaz. Ainsley Ndlovu comes on for his first stint in T20Is.

OUT! LBW! umpire's call! The review is retained but Gurbaz' fun is over. Williams strikes. The slider, pitching around off and skidding on, Rahmanullah looks to sweep but misses. Is hit on the pads, Williams appeals and the umpire raises his finger. Gurbaz has a chat with his partner and then takes the review. The third umpire takes a while to confirm whether there is no inside edge. The ball is pretty close to the gloves but eventually, he is convinced that the spike on Ultra Edge is not due to the gloves. Ball Tracker shows the ball to be clipping leg stump, which means umpire's call will stay. 43 from 24 for the debutant.
Gurbaz has been adjudged LBW! He takes the review after a thought. Looks close. Not hitting the gloves.
Outside off, punched off the back foot for a run.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Outside off, played straight to point.

SAFE as a house. Boy, that took a long time coming, didn't it? Full and outside off, Tarakai looked to defend but was beaten in flight. His back foot came out slightly, was in the air but then it came back in. Taylor behind collected the ball and whipped the bails off in a flash. In the very first replay, it seemed that the foot had landed safely before the bails went off. Still, the third umpire takes ages before eventually pressing the right button.
STUMPING APPEAL! Taylor looks confident. Is Tarakai in trouble? Replays seem to show that the back foot is in.
On middle, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, pushed towards cover for a quick single. 9 runs and a wicket from the final Powerplay over as Afghanistan end that phase on 58/1.
Around off, pushed towards cover.
Najeeb Tarakai walks in at number 3, replacing Zazai.

OUT! Caught. So it will not be a wicketless Powerplay. A wicket falls at last. A length ball, outside off, Hazratullah swings hard but he is slightly early into his shot. The ball comes much later than his anticipation and takes the top edge. Simple catch for Sean Williams at sweeper cover. Wonder what was the need for that slog with Gurbaz going so well at the other end.
Outside off, pushed through point for a run.
SIX! ADMONISHED! A short ball, around middle, Gurbaz picks it off his hips and pulls it over fine leg!
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a single.
Tendai Chatara is back on. 1-0-10-0 so far.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
WIDE. Down the leg side, flick shot missed.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
Goes back to pull but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Goes for another slog sweep but this time he misses. Is hit on the chest. Williams looks to appeal but then bails out. Probably it was too high.
SIX! WHOOSH! Oh ya... leftie to bowl and leftie to bat. Outta here! Flighted outside off, Zazai now puts his attacking mode on. Gets down on a knee and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket!
Sean Williams into the attack now.

FOUR! And again! Landed outside off, Gurbaz looks to swing this time. To the leg side. Does not make any difference. He is slow once more and the ball takes the outside edge once again. Clears short third man once again. 13 from the over, 34 from the last 3!
FOUR! Off the outside edge. Full and outside off, Gurbaz looks to go straight down the ground but gets a thick outside edge which flies over short third man!

Ouch! Almost on the head. A short ball, outside off, Rahmanullah looks to pull but misses and is hit on the neck. Almost on the head, just below the vizor. He is okay. The ball goes to backward point.
FOUR! Nicely done! Around middle, Gurbaz gets down and across and paddles it wide of short fine leg for a boundary!
Outside off, steered behind point for a single.
On middle and leg, flicked straight to square leg.
SIX! Terrific shot! A length ball, on middle and leg, Gurbaz whips it over fine leg for a biggie! 10 from the over, 21 off the last 2!
Full on middle, chipped over mid on. The fielder runs back to catch but cannot get there. Two runs taken.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid on for a quick run.
DROPPED! Never easy to catch those. On middle, pretty straight, Zazai hammers this straight back. The bowler sticks out his right hand but the ball bursts through his fingers.
Landed outside off, a bit of extra bounce, fended off the gloves to the off side for a run.
Full and outside off, watchfully pushed towards the off side. Gurbaz wants a single.
Tendai Chatara comes in as the first change, pretty early.
Another pull shot. This is through mid-wicket but does not travel. But the batsmen travel nicely, running hard between the wickets, for three runs. 11 from the over!
FOUR! WHAM! A short ball, outside off, Gurbaz swivels, gets across and pulls this through square leg for boundaries in succession!
FOUR! Up and over! First boundary of the game. Landed outside off, Gurbaz backs away a touch and lofts it over wide mid off. One bounce and into the fence.
Outside off, on a length, Gurbaz looks to push but the ball goes off the inside edge past the stumps towards short fine leg.
Around off, watchfully defended.
Landed outside off, Gurbaz looks to defend but the ball moves away after pitching, beating the outside edge.
Kyle Jarvis to share the new-ball attack with Ndlovu.
On middle and leg, worked through mid-wicket for a couple.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads for a single.
Full and outside off, Gurbaz looks to sweep but misses. The keeper misses too and it is a couple.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Works this through mid-wicket for a single.
We are all set for the game to begin. Rahmanullah Gurbaz and Hazratullah Zazai will open for the Afghans. Ainsley Ndlovu will bowl with the new ball. Debutant to debutant. Gurbaz to face. Here we go!

Zimbabwe (Playing XI) - Brendan Taylor(wk), Hamilton Masakadza(c), Craig Ervine, Sean Williams, Regis Chakabva (IN FOR MARUMA), Ryan Burl, Tinotenda Mutombodzi, Neville Madziva, Kyle Jarvis, Ainsley Ndlovu (DEBUT, IN FOR MUNYONGA) and Tendai Chatara.

Afghanistan (Playing XI) - Hazratullah Zazai, Najibullah Zadran, Gulbadin Naib, Najeeb Tarakai, Rahmanullah Gurbaz(WK, DEBUT), Asghar Afghan, Mohammad Nabi, Rashid Khan(c), Mujeeb Ur Rahman, Karim Janat and Fareed Ahmad.
TOSS - It is time for the spin of the coin. Hamilton Masakadza calls it right and ZIMBABWE WILL CHASE tonight.
WEATHER - Good news, first up. No rain right now. We have a start on time. Clear, sunny skies.

After a thriller in the opening game, is the tri-series nicely set up? You bet it has. Zimbabwe might have lost but they won many hearts as they made Bangladesh run for their money. Tonight, they take on a tougher opposition in Afghanistan. Will they be able to keep up the intensity? Hello and a warm welcome to the second game of the tri-series in Dhaka.
